description: The file contains C++ classes and code for the libwebsockets library, including classes for managing secure streams, exceptions, buffers, and specific stream types such as message and file streams. It defines various classes, methods, and structures for handling websocket-secure stream functionality within the library.

classes.name: lssException
classes.description: Exception subclass for lss-specific issues, holding error details and overriding what() method.

classes.name: lssbuf_t
classes.description: Buffer structure holding a pointer to data and its length.

classes.name: lssAc
classes.description: Class managing an array of buffers, supporting append and get operations.

classes.name: lssPriv
classes.description: Class storing private userdata associated with secure streams, including pointers to handle and context.

classes.name: lss
classes.description: Base class representing a secure stream, managing creation, association, and completion.

classes.name: lssMsg
classes.description: Subclass for atomic message streams on the heap.

classes.name: lssFile
classes.description: Subclass handling file-based transactions in secure streams, supporting write operation.
